pli-tv-pvr13:1.2: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ codesi kimhi naṃ codesi sīlavipattiyā codesi ācāravipattiyā codesi diṭṭhivipattiyā codesīti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.4: sīlavipattiyā vā codemi ācāravipattiyā vā codemi diṭṭhivipattiyā vā codemīti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.5: jānāti panāyasmā sīlavipattiṃ jānāti ācāravipattiṃ jānāti diṭṭhivipattinti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.7: jānāmi kho ahaṃ āvuso sīlavipattiṃ jānāmi ācāravipattiṃ jānāmi diṭṭhivipattinti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.12: cattāri pārājikāni terasa saṅghādisesā ayaṃ sīlavipatti
pli-tv-pvr13:1.13: thullaccayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ayaṃ ācāravipatti
pli-tv-pvr13:1.14: micchādiṭṭhi antaggāhikā diṭṭhi ayaṃ daṭṭhivipattīti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.15: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ codesi diṭṭhena codesi sutena codesi parisaṅkāya codesīti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.17: diṭṭhena vā codemi sutena vā codemi parisaṅkāya vā codemīti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.18: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ diṭṭhena codesi kinte diṭṭhaṃ kinti te diṭṭhaṃ kadā te diṭṭhaṃ kattha te diṭṭhaṃ pārājikaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho thullaccayaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho
pli-tv-pvr13:1.22: ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho kattha ca tvaṃ ahosi kattha cāyaṃ bhikkhu ahosi kiñca tvaṃ karosi kiñcāyaṃ bhikkhu karotīti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.24: na kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ diṭṭhena codemi apica sutena codemīti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.25: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ sutena codesi kinte sutaṃ kinti te sutaṃ kadā te sutaṃ kattha te sutaṃ pārājikaṃ ajjhāpannoti sutaṃ saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpannoti sutaṃ
pli-tv-pvr13:1.30: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpannoti sutaṃ bhikkhussa sutaṃ bhikkhuniyā sutaṃ sikkhamānāya sutaṃ sāmaṇerassa sutaṃ sāmaṇeriyā sutaṃ upāsakassa sutaṃ upāsikāya sutaṃ rājūnaṃ sutaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ sutaṃ titthiyānaṃ sutaṃ titthiyasāvakānaṃ sutanti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.32: na kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ sutena codemi apica parisaṅkāya codemīti. so evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-pvr13:1.33: yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ parisaṅkāya codesi kiṃ parisaṅkasi kinti parisaṅkasi kadā parisaṅkasi kattha parisaṅkasi pārājikaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi thullaccayaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi
pli-tv-pvr13:1.37: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi bhikkhussa sutvā parisaṅkasi bhikkhuniyā sutvā parisaṅkasi sikkhamānāya sutvā parisaṅkasi sāmaṇerassa sutvā parisaṅkasi sāmaṇeriyā sutvā parisaṅkasi upāsakassa sutvā parisaṅkasi upāsikāya sutvā parisaṅkasi rājūnaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasi rājamahāmattānaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasi titthiyānaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasi titthiyasāvakānaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasīti.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.1: codanāya ko ādi kiṃ majjhe kiṃ pariyosānaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.2: codanāya okāsakammaṃ ādi kiriyā majjhe samatho pariyosānaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.3: codanāya kati mūlāni kati vatthūni kati bhūmiyo katīhākārehi codeti.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.4: codanāya dve mūlāni tīṇi vatthūni pañca bhūmiyo dvīhākārehi codeti.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.12: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena atthasañhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasañhitena mettacitto vakkhāmi no dosantaroti
pli-tv-pvr13:6.2: kāyena vā codeti vācāya vā codeti
pli-tv-pvr13:7.6: codakena pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya paro codetabbo
pli-tv-pvr13:7.7: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena atthasañhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasañhitena metatacitto vakkhāmi no dosantaroti.
pli-tv-pvr13:7.17: anuvijjakena yena dhammena yena vinayena yena satthusāsanena taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
